**Date:** The final cost was confirmed on 14 March 2024, when the repair was formally signed off as complete.

**Person:** Marguerite Oyelaran-Voss, Director of Capital Works at the Halvern Basin Water Authority, announced the total.

**Figure:** The 48 million total was 20% above the original estimate of 40 million, with the overrun attributed to reinforcing the eastern spillway wall.

**Source document:** The Authority's Tamsin Reservoir Project Closeout Report (Ref. HBWA-CR-2024-07), presented at its public board meeting.
